notes: REF-BM-02: metadata fetch collects only title+description; favicon is generated initials placeholder and no preview image is fetched. REF-BM-06: save always unshifts a new item with a fresh id, no duplicate-url detection/convergence. REF-BM-10: tags entered via plain text input, no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring match, no #tag syntax (tags stored without #). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-20: no multi-select UI or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-scoped bulk action. REF-BM-23: note field exists but is rendered as escaped plain text, not markdown. REF-BM-24: no snapshot/PDF storage. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: collections are a static hardcoded list, not saved search/tag-filter bundles. REF-BM-30: no import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no personal display settings (default sort/displayed items/font size); sort/layout are transient controls only.
